01 / About

An engineer across the full platform lifecycle.

I’m a Systems Engineer with 4+ years of professional experience building and maintaining web platforms, administering Linux-based infrastructure, and troubleshooting production systems.

My work combines hands-on delivery with technical coordination: collaborating with clients and stakeholders, clarifying requirements, defining approaches with the team, reviewing work, and coordinating delivery. I also take on independent web projects and am currently pursuing an online M.S. in Artificial Intelligence.
